continuity: Baeksang has publicly accused Jin Taekyung of being the culprit behind the Inner Palace tragedy and has presented a broad faction-backed alibi for himself.
The Beast Miao King and Yayul Mok publicly confirm that Jin's residence was attacked by unidentified assassins shortly after the banquet.
Namho warns Jin through concealed finger-writing not to disclose his meeting with Heugung because the meeting cannot currently be verified.
Baeksang has summoned Utu-ri, the old noodle-shop owner, as a witness or source of evidence before the assembled chieftains.
plot: Baeksang publicly identifies Jin as the culprit behind the Western Yao Estate massacre and turns the gathering into a trial, while Jin refuses to yield the initiative and asserts his innocence.

The Beast Miao King arrives and questions Jin about the tragedy; Jin denies any connection, and the Beast Miao King and Yayul Mok confirm that Jin's quarters were attacked by unidentified assassins. Baeksang counters by emphasizing the apparent contradiction that such assassins were strong enough to threaten a Supreme Peak master.

Baeksang establishes an alibi supported by fifteen chieftains and one hundred warriors, then asks Jin where he was. Namho secretly signals Jin to say nothing, since revealing his meeting with Heugung cannot be proved. Baeksang then summons Utu-ri, the old owner of the noodle shop, who arrives at the Western Yao Estate gate.
translation_decisions: Render 남백부 as Southern Bai Estate.
Render 경파족장 as Jingpo Chieftain, 납호족 as Lahu people, and 와족 as Wa people.

active_continuity: Jin remains in the Nanman Beast Palace's Inner Palace as the Third Young Master of the Jin Family of Taiyuan and head of the Fire Dragon Pavilion.
The Fire Dragon Pavilion was attacked after Jin left, and Dark Heaven is suspected of organizing or enabling the assault.
Yohi's Western Yao Estate was attacked by a Supreme Peak master, killing more than a hundred Yao warriors and beasts.
Jin and Yayul Mok believe Dark Heaven directly intervened and likely deployed a Supreme Peak master, but the motive is unknown.
Baeksang and the Beast Miao King are the only two known Supreme Peak masters in Nanman.
Heugung genuinely loves Yohi and had promised to cooperate with Jin.
Heugung visited Yohi with four guards, who were killed; a wrist believed to be his was found, but his death is unconfirmed.
Faint footprints indicate that a third party abducted or confronted Heugung and Yohi rather than the incident being their staged attack.
Yohi and Heugung remain missing from the Inner Palace.
Yohi's nearly scentless pouch remains a possible clue.
Baeksang has publicly accused Jin of the Inner Palace massacre and backed his own alibi with fifteen chieftains and one hundred warriors.
Namho has warned Jin not to reveal his unverifiable meeting with Heugung, while Baeksang has summoned Utu-ri as a witness.
open_questions: Who was the Supreme Peak attacker, and what did Dark Heaven seek by intervening directly?
Are Heugung and Yohi alive, and where were they taken?
What can be learned from Yohi's nearly scentless pouch?
Is Baeksang truly colluding with Dark Heaven despite the evidence of third-party intervention?
What testimony or evidence will Utu-ri provide, and how will it affect the accusation against Jin?
temporary_decisions: Retain Force for 강기 and Supreme Peak for 초절정.
Render 서요부 as Western Yao Estate and 동이부 as Eastern Yi Estate.
Render 무언 as No words and 남백부 as Southern Bai Estate.
